text: Sara - Archie starts reception Weds. she's more nervous than him lol. text her that afternoon to see how drop off went
Ryan & Alice housewarming Sat from 7. new place in Didsbury. bring wine, Alice doesn't drink so smth non-alc too
Luca graduating Thurs 11am @ Bridgewater Hall - mum, dad + his nonna flying in the day before. must send congrats card
Adebayo's daughter - GCSE results next Thurs morning. he's pretending he's calm. he's not
dinner @ Stefan & Lars Fri 8pm. cancelled - Lars has covid. rebook for after half term

Abigail - eldest (Leah) off to Leeds uni Sun. driving her up early, back late. Abigail held it together on the phone but she's clearly gutted, house v quiet w/out her, younger one Lucy still at home tho. Leah's sharing a flat w/ 5 others, already complaining about the kitchen. check in w/ Abigail Mon evening
Suzanne invited me to her 50th, 14th Nov at half 7, Florin's doing the cooking. she'd love that gin from the distillery tour, hint hint
Tomás - driving test tmrw at 9:40. 3rd attempt. v anxious. wish him luck tonight
Eli & Leah - engagement drinks Sat 4pm @ the Crown. Leah's sister Shira organising. ask Shira if they need help setting up that morning
Callum's lad Mateo had first day @ big school today, came home buzzing apparently. Callum teared up at the gate

Simone - PhD viva 3 Dec 10am. struggling w/ the examiner's comments on ch 4, she says the external is famously brutal. Gareth's taking the day off to drive her in, then dinner afterwards w/ her parents if it goes ok. she's barely sleeping. call her the wk before, maybe take her for coffee the day after
Svetlana - Gareth's mum. 80th next month, big family lunch. Gareth wants us there. ask him the date
Alina's twins - nativity Tues 2pm. she asked if I could film it, she's stuck @ work till 3
Farid back from Lahore. dad's ok now after the op. Farid knackered
Rohan - got into Cambridge!! offer came this morning. his mum Elena already told half the street
Lucy - leaving do Fri after work, 5:30 @ Brewdog. she's off to Bristol, new job starts 1st. get a card round the office Weds
Kofi & Ebony having a bbq Sun midday - kids' bday combined, Eli 6, Alina 4. Ebony said lego, anything lego
Kavya - Santiago proposed in Lisbon last wk!! wedding prob next summer. send flowers
Sam - year 6 SATs in May, his mum Suzanne says he's v worried about maths. not urgent, just good to know
birthday drinks Sat 9pm - mine. booked table @ Albert's Schloss. tell Ryan + Alice the time
Archie - new puppy, cockapoo called Biscuit. kids obsessed. Sara less so
Stefan - how did Lars's interview go Thurs? forgot to ask @ footy. msg him tonight
chat w/ Leah re her mum - scan results back fri. she's trying not to think about it. text sat morning
Luca Rossi (Lucky) - moving to Turin end of Jan. leaving party some time Jan, he'll confirm
Gareth & Simone - 10th anniv Weds. he's surprising her w/ Paris, Eurostar Tues evening, back Sun. mustn't mention to Simone
Florin - his son Santiago graduates from Sandhurst Fri morning, whole family going down Thurs. he's so proud
Eli - started @ Deloitte mon. ask how 1st wk went

Ebony's dad - funeral Weds 11am, St Mary's, wake afterwards @ the cricket club. I'm going w/ Kofi, picking him up at 10. Ebony's holding up, her brother Farid not so much. take a card + flowers for her mum. check in w/ Ebony a few days after
Abigail Shah (Abi) - vegan now, also coeliac. note for xmas dinner
Ryan - school concert tmrw 6pm, Shira's first solo. he's more nervous than she is. ask how it went the next day
Alina - promoted to head of year!! starts after Easter. drinks to celebrate some time next wk
Svetlana - knee op went fine, home Thurs. cooking a lasagne for her and Gareth sat
text Tomás re his sister Elena's christening - Sun 2 Nov, 11:30, St Peter's. need to confirm we're coming by Fri
Kavya - rough wk. mum moving in w/ them, dad's dementia getting worse. pop round w/ cake
collect suit from dry cleaners before Fri 5pm. car MOT sat morning
Mateo's 18th - Callum throwing a party @ the rugby club 22nd, 8 till late. Mateo wants a Playstation 5 apparently, Callum says no chance

Suzanne - Florin's retirement do Fri 7pm @ the golf club, 30 yrs at the council. she's doing a speech, panicking about it, keeps rewriting. I said I'd read it over Thurs evening. their son Tomás flying back from Madrid that afternoon for it. Florin has no idea, thinks it's just drinks w/ the team. he's into fly fishing - she says a new reel wd go down well
Lars - dog Pepper went missing Sun, found Mon morning in a neighbour's shed. ask how she's doing
Kofi - can't make Sat dinner, Ebony's sick. moved to next Fri 7:30 same place
Sara + Luca's housewarming - did Archie get the invite? check w/ Sara
Rohan's 21st was last night - huge. Elena did all the food, hours of prep the day before. thank her

Leah - nursery settling in for Sam next wk. first two days mornings only, full days from the Weds. Leah back @ work the mon after, 3 days a wk. she's dreading the handover, Sam's never been left w/ anyone except her mum. her partner Callum's doing pickups. ask her how the first morning went
Farid - works nights @ the Royal now, A&E. sleeps till 2
Adebayo + his wife - 25th anniv party 8th Feb, 7pm onwards. she loves orchids
Simone - job interview @ BBC 9am Mon. she's fine about it, prepped for wks
Shira's graduation - got the date wrong. it's the 18th not 17th, ceremony 2pm, lunch afterwards @ Dishoom w/ her parents + gran. I'm booking the table
mum's bday 30th. book restaurant

Santiago - first marathon Sun, Chester, starts 9am. Kavya + kids at mile 20 w/ a banner. he's been training since Feb, knee strapped. text him good luck sat night, then congrats sun afternoon. dinner @ theirs the following Sat to celebrate
Gareth - redundancy meeting tmrw 10am. v stressed. don't forget to call him after
Callum - Mateo's A level results Thurs. results at 8am, Callum taking the day off. ask that evening
Lucy Baker - cat Mochi had surgery today, back legs. Lucy v upset, vet bill huge
Alice - her brother Sam's wedding in Crete next June. she's maid of... best woman? she's thrilled. Ryan less keen on the flights
party @ Stefan's Sat - his 40th. starts 3pm in the garden, kids welcome, bring a chair. Lars said Stefan wants a new grill brush, old one's rubbish
Eli, Archie & Ryan - 5-a-side tournament Sun 10am @ Powerleague. Eli's hamstring dodgy. Ryan reckons they'll win, Archie doubts it
Ebony - Alina's first ballet show Sat 1pm, Ebony's mum coming up Fri night to watch. must ask Ebony for ticket link
Alina - Mum's diagnosis appointment tmrw afternoon @ 4. Alina going with her, wants me to keep her company in the waiting room. I'll pick them both up at 3:15
nothing much - quick catch up w/ Stefan @ school gates. he's into sourdough now
Kavya's son Rohan - exams all next wk, Mon-Fri, mornings. stressed. Kavya too. send her a msg Fri afternoon when he's done
Sam - first day @ Google tmrw. starts 9:30, lunch with team afterwards. he's terrified tbh. text him in the morning

Ryan's mum Svetlana - 70th surprise party Sat 4th at half 6 @ the Mill. Ryan + Alice organising, need everyone there by 6. Svetlana thinks it's a quiet dinner w/ the two of them. Alice asked me to bring the cake from Lucy's bakery that morning, collection 10am. also chip in for her present - garden bench, £20 each, send to Alice by Thurs. don't tell Svetlana's sister Lucy, she can't keep secrets lol
